answer: R3 is about twice as sensitive to ambient humidity as the other reactors. Humidity rose from ~50-55% (spring) to 75-85% from week 14 onward in all reactors, which explains the common yield drop (~27.5 to ~23-24). R3 yield falls from 28.1 (<50% RH) to 21.5 g/g-cat (>80% RH), a drop of 6.6, versus about 3.2-3.5 for R1, R2 and R4. At 70%+ humidity R3 is ~2-3 g/g-cat below the others (21.5-21.8 vs 23.6-24.8). Not explained by: catalyst lot (same lots FC-2606/07/08 in all reactors, R3 still 2-4 lower in each), 2-zone temperature (R3 flat, same as R1/R4), or uptime (noisy, no R3 trend). Suggested next check: R3 humidity ingress (gas line, seals, dryer/purge).
